name: zvideo_dd_unlock_surface_wait_restore
description: zVideo_dd::UnlockSurface_WaitRestore unlocks an IDirectDrawSurface3, retries after successful Restore on DDERR_SURFACELOST, and returns the 0x5a56ffff sentinel after reporting permanent failures.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zVideo DirectDraw surface-lock source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4a8160 validates fastcall ECX=IDirectDrawSurface3*, provider IDirectDrawSurface3::Unlock through vtable offset 0x80 with null unlock argument, DDERR_SURFACELOST handling through provider Restore at vtable offset 0x6c, retry when Restore returns DD_OK, ReportError with zvid_dd.c line 0x21b for permanent unlock/restore failures, return 0 on successful Unlock, and return 0x5a56ffff on failure.
Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x4a8160 has no warnings and matches the existing source implementation. The only non-provider authored callee is zVideo_dd::ReportError, which is tier C or better.
The dependency frontier shows no remaining authored source blockers; Unlock and Restore are DirectDraw provider calls.

The native smoke installs a fake DirectDrawSurface3 provider table and verifies the direct unlock success path, DDERR_SURFACELOST plus successful Restore retry path, lost-surface Restore failure path, generic unlock failure path, null Unlock argument, and the 0x5a56ffff failure sentinel.
